request.input:
1girl, solo, full body, standing, crossed legs, arms at sides, looking at viewer, confident smile, small fang.

A single complete full-length game character portrait on a plain white background.

Vertical composition, centered figure. Entire ponytail, sword hilt, scabbard tip and both boots inside the canvas, with a little clear margin above the head and below the feet. Hands relaxed beside the skirt. One sheathed straight black longsword strapped diagonally across her back: hilt above her right shoulder (screen left), scabbard tip behind her left leg (screen right), ending just below the knee.

Soft cool daylight, clear facial features, silver hair highlights, restrained black and charcoal clothing with blue ribbon accents.

arknights, game promotional illustration, painterly anime illustration. Complete, clean silhouettes and carefully resolved facial features and hands. Use clear grouped shadows and angular cloth folds. Keep fine linework selective around the eyes, fingers and accessories. Skin has delicate restrained transitions. Alternate crisp focal edges with softer background edges while keeping contours complete. Rich but controlled color, precise focal detail, quieter background detail.
